units.source_text: 既然地上有风，有流动，那沙地的形成，也许是在所难免的。

en.t: Since there is wind and movement on the earth, the formation of sandy ground may have been unavoidable.

units.source_text: 只要风在吹，河在流，海上波浪在翻腾，

en.t: As long as the wind blows, the rivers flow, and the waves churn on the sea,

units.source_text: 沙子就会从土壤中生出来，简直像活的东西一样，不择地势蔓延开来。

en.t: sand will be born from the soil and spread out over any terrain, almost like a living thing.
The movement of sand never comes to an end.

units.source_text: 静静地、实实在在地侵犯着地表，吞噬着地表……

en.t: Quietly and steadily, it encroaches upon the surface of the earth and devours it...
